paragraphs.source_en: Osode was just about to rebuke them for their rude and overbearing conduct when Yoshinaga spoke first. “Are you Osode?”

units.source_zh: 阿袖刚要斥责他们的粗暴无礼，幸长却先开了口：“你是阿袖？”

paragraphs.source_en: “Mind your manners! Lord Sakyo, it is true that I was once Osode of Hakata… but now I am the concubine of the Assistant Minister of Civil Administration.”

units.source_en: Lord Sakyo, it is true that I was once Osode of Hakata… but now I am the concubine of the Assistant Minister of Civil Administration.”

paragraphs.source_zh: “你们休得无礼！左京大人，不错，小女子以前确是博多的阿袖……而如今，我乃治部少辅侍妾。”

paragraphs.source_en: “Hmph! We have come to negotiate with Jibu. Bring Jibu out at once!”

paragraphs.source_en: Their fitful discussion echoed in Osode’s ears. It seemed they were determined to continue the pursuit. paragraphs.source_zh: 议论声时断时续回响在阿袖耳畔，看来，他们定要继续追下去。忽然，耳边传来杂贺兵部的声音：“夫人，大人离开期间，小的得把您看好。您好生待在府里吧。”
